newsitem.title: PERU: British steel interested in Camisea pipeline.
newsitem.headline: British steel interested in Camisea pipeline.

text.p: British Steel said it was interested in participating in the construction of a natural gas pipeline from Peru's Camisea field.

Jim Jamieson, British Steel's general manager for sales and marketing, told reporters late Wednesday during a visit to Peru that the company would approach the Royal Dutch Shell Co to see if it could become involved in the project.
He did not give more details.

In May, Shell, with Mobil, signed a 40-year contract with the Peruvian government to explore and exploit the huge Camisea oil and gas field in the mainly jungle department of Cusco, 300 miles (500 km) east of Lima.

The Camisea project foresees total investment of at least $2.7 billion in the first 30 years, according to the Ministry of Energy and Mines. That money will be spend on producing, treating and transporting gas and liquids to Lima.
